segments.name: Retail grocery
segments.description: Operates supermarkets in the southeast United States selling grocery, perishables, non-food products and fuel to retail customers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates one primary business segment, retail grocery, on a 52- or 53-week fiscal year ending on the last Saturday in September.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the Company for grocery, perishable, non-food and fuel purchases at its supermarkets, and other retailers, food service distributors and grocery warehouses buy products from its fluid dairy plant.
revenueModel.evidence: In addition, the milk processing and packaging plant sells approximately 81% of its products to other retailers, food service distributors and grocery warehouses in 18 states, which provides the Company with an additional source of revenue.

changes.text: In fiscal year 2025, the expense allocation methodology changed to move shopping center rental costs out of the retail segment, with fiscal 2024 and 2023 recast to be comparable.
changes.evidence: For fiscal year 2025, our expense allocation methodology changed to include direct and indirect costs associated with the shopping center rentals that were previously included in the retail segment.
